title: MapleStory M May 20/21, 2026 Patch Notes Part 1
original_title: 05.20/21 Patch Notes Pt.1 (Aran and Shade Remastered, Boss Content Improvements, Emblem Improvements)
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Part 1 of the May 20/21 update remastered Aran and Shade, revised their skills, quests and regions, expanded character slots, improved Emblems and boss content, and reorganized Character Info and stat-source displays.
notes: Structured summary verified against the official Nexon Forum patch note on 2026-07-27.
changes: Remastered Aran and Shade skills, quests, appearances, and related regions.
Expanded the maximum character-slot count to 65.
Improved Emblem enhancement, extraction, and crafting.
Improved boss content and Character Info stat-source displays.
resolved_issues: Corrected Aran and Shade skill descriptions that did not match the in-game text.
